'''Chime trees''' were exotic [[tree]]s whose silver [[Flower/Legends|flowers]] rang like bells.

[[Gardulla Besadii the Elder/Legends|Gardulla the Hutt]]—a connoisseur in exotic alien creatures, which she unabashedly housed in [[Imperial Station Bravo|her great palace]] near the [[Dune Sea/Legends|Dune Sea]] on Tatooine—prized these arborial ornaments in her luxurious if notorious indoor [[Gardulla's pleasure garden|pleasure garden]].
